hero.hero_subtitle: Our professional fee is based on the nature, scope and complexity of your requirement, and is clearly discussed and agreed with you before we proceed.

seo_description: How Aventrix Realty approaches professional fees and brokerage in Chennai — the scope is explained clearly and the fee is agreed with you before we proceed.

fields.lead: A residential purchase, a land transaction, a commercial lease and a Joint Venture assignment can each involve very different levels of work, coordination and responsibility.
fields.text: That is why Aventrix Realty does not apply one fixed fee to every assignment. We first understand your requirement, define the scope of our involvement, and then agree the applicable professional fee, commonly referred to as brokerage, with you.

items.title: Nature of Transaction
items.text: Buying, selling, leasing, land, Joint Venture or advisory assignments.

items.title: Property & Transaction Value
items.text: The type and value of the property, and of the transaction.

items.title: Scope of Work
items.text: The services required and the level of our involvement.

items.title: Complexity
items.text: The stakeholders, documentation, negotiations and coordination involved.

items.title: Professional Involvement
items.text: The time, expertise and transaction support the assignment calls for.

fields.note: Professional fees are applicable based on the nature and scope of the assignment.

services.title: Buying
services.text: Property search, evaluation and transaction support.

services.title: Selling
services.text: Property positioning, buyer engagement and negotiation support.

services.title: Land & Plots
services.text: Land transactions, opportunity assessment and coordination.

services.title: Joint Ventures
services.text: Coordination between landowners and developers on development opportunities.

services.title: NRI Property Services
services.text: Remote property assistance and transaction coordination.

sections.label: How we agree your fee (4 steps)
sections.heading: How We Agree Your Fee

fields.text: The same four steps apply to every assignment, whatever its size.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We understand your property, requirement and objectives.

steps.title: Define
steps.text: We establish the scope of our involvement and the services required.

steps.title: Agree
steps.text: The applicable professional fee, payment terms and applicable taxes are discussed and confirmed.

steps.title: Proceed
steps.text: We begin the assignment once the terms are mutually agreed.

points.title: Clear Communication
points.text: You will know the applicable fee before we proceed.

points.title: Written Terms
points.text: The agreed fee and payment terms are clearly documented where applicable.

points.title: No Unexpected Changes
points.text: The agreed fee does not change unless the scope changes and revised terms are mutually agreed.

points.title: Professional Transparency
points.text: We explain what the fee covers, which party it applies to and when it is payable.

panels.title: Taxes & Invoicing
panels.text: Where applicable, GST and other statutory taxes will be charged in accordance with applicable laws. Applicable fees and taxes will be communicated as part of the agreed commercial terms.

panels.title: Clear Terms Before We Proceed
panels.text: Aventrix Realty charges professional fees for its real estate services. The applicable fee depends on the nature and scope of the assignment and is discussed with the client before proceeding.
panels.text2: Where a written fee agreement is in place, its agreed terms will apply.

fields.text: Tell us what you are looking to buy, sell, lease or develop. We'll understand your requirement, explain the scope of our involvement and discuss the applicable professional fee with you before proceeding.
